column1: # The AD104 MMQ stream-K grid matrix. Every arm runs at ne11 17, the first
# column count at which Q4_K, Q6_K, and Q8_0 all reach MMQ under the promoted
# closure 88681bf4d161: mmvq.cu:295-306 as the crossover patch configures it
# admits Q4_K to MMVQ through seven columns, Q6_K through ten, and Q8_0 through
# sixteen, and ggml_cuda_should_use_mmq at mmq.cu:312 takes every type above its
# own threshold. Sixteen would send the Q8_0 arms back to MMVQ and void them.
# ggml_cuda_mmq_get_config at mmq.cuh:247-249 routes every NVIDIA part at Volta
# or later into ggml_cuda_mmq_get_config_ampere, whose 352 CASE rows all set
# stream_k true, so stream-K is the decomposition on this device rather than a
# decision. What varies at run time is the grid: mmq.cuh:1436 sets
# block_nums_stream_k to ntiles_dst where tiles_efficiency_percent reaches 90
# and to the multiprocessor count otherwise, and mmq.cuh:1440 sets fixup_needed
# from ntiles_dst % block_nums_stream_k.x. At the tiling grid the modulo is zero
# and one kernel ends the pass; otherwise mmq.cuh:1463 launches
# mul_mat_q_stream_k_fixup over the partial tiles mmq.cuh:936 sent to tmp_fixup.
# patches/llama-cuda-mmq-stream-k-grid.patch makes that 90 a build-configured
# value on Ada Lovelace alone. Four closures appear here and differ by that one
# value: the promoted control at the upstream 90 without the patch, the null
# closure carrying the patch at its default 90, the candidate at 80, and the
# tiling closure at 1, where every shape takes the tiling grid and the fixup
# launch disappears from the capture entirely.
# The regime of each arm is fixed at authoring time from the artifact's own
# tensor shapes, read out of the GGUF headers with I = 128 (every Ampere CASE
# row), ntx = 1 at ne11 17, ntzw = 1 for a dense mat-mul, and nsm = 60 as an
# observation (grid 60 for mmq16 in evidence/ada/mmvq-mmq-occupancy-ad104/).
# ntiles_dst is then ceil(nrows_x / 128) per weight, and the note column carries
# the row classes each arm's flip acts on. Threshold 80 flips the 48-tile class
# alone, which the 2B and the 0.8B carry and the 4B does not, so the 4B arm at
# 80 is a per-model null rather than a subject.
# Arms run 2B first, 0.8B second, 4B third, the class order CLAUDE.md sets for a
# general runtime experiment, control and subject alternate inside a class so
# each reading is paired, and the opening arm repeats last as the closing
# control.
